# Pathway Academy Zone
> Specialist Alternative Provision (AP) academy in Stoke-on-Trent supporting young people aged 11–16 with personalised, trauma-informed education.

Pathway Academy Zone (PAZ) provides structured learning environments for students who have become disengaged from mainstream education. Our approach combines academic rigour with therapeutic support and vocational opportunities.

## Contact
- [Contact Page](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/contact): General enquiries and location details.
- Email: info@pathwayacademyzone.co.uk
- Phone: +44 1782 365365
- Address: Duncalf St, Burslem, Stoke-on-Trent ST6 3LJ

## Services
- [Academic Re-engagement](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/academic-re-engagement): Core subjects including English, Maths, and Science.
- [Vocational Learning](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/vocational-learning): Hands-on training and career-focused skills.
- [SEMH Support](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/semh-support): Therapeutic support for social, emotional, and mental health needs.
- [Personal Development](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/personal-development): Building resilience and confidence.
- [Life Skills](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/life-skills): Practical skills for independence.
- [Employability Skills](https://pathwayacademyzone.co.uk/programmes/employability-skills): Preparation for post-16 transitions and work.

## What We Do Not Do
- We do not provide long-term residential care.
- We are not a mainstream secondary school; we are an Alternative Provision.
- We do not accept self-referrals from parents without school or local authority involvement.
